item.title: About
item.description: Written in Go, Hugo is an open source static site generator available under the Apache Licence 2.0. Hugo supports TOML, YAML and JSON data file types, Markdown and HTML content files and uses shortcodes to add rich content. Other notable features are taxonomies, multilingual mode, image processing, custom output formats, HTML/CSS/JS minification and support for Sass SCSS workflows. Hugo makes use of a variety of open source projects including: https://github.com/yuin/goldmark https://github.

item.title: Academic Publications
item.description: I am interested in the study of fraud detection within public procurement and private spending, as well as the broader challenge of identifying and mitigating abuse in various domains. My research focuses on developing analytical methods and decision support systems to uncover irregularities and promote integrity in organizational processes. A Decision Support System for Fraud Detection in Public Procurement Published in International Transactions in Operational Research, this article presents a decision support system developed to identify corruption risk patterns in Brazilian public procurement.
